summary: Configured and verified a persistent firewalld policy on node1: SSH is allowed, TCP/9000 is accepted only from node2 (10.100.6.11), and rejected from node3 and all other sources. All three nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Added ordered runtime and permanent firewalld rich rules on node1.
Verified node2 can reach TCP/9000 while node3 is rejected.
Verified SSH remains reachable from node2 and node3.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified recovery.
Removed the temporary TCP/9000 test listener.

evidence.summary: firewalld is enabled and active; runtime and permanent node2-accept and catch-all-reject rules are present; configuration validation succeeded.
